title: Acoustic line source in water: 2D Green's function (analytic)
description:
A cw monopole (volume_source, 1 MHz, volume rate Q per m of z) at the centre of a 14.8 mm water square with absorbing faces (elastic_waves; 40 cells per wavelength, 1-wavelength CPML inside the domain), run for ~40 periods.
Analytic (fluid, source term rho Q ds/dt, s = sin(w t), time convention exp(+j w t)): p(r, t) = (w rho Q / 4) [J0(k r) sin(w t) - Y0(k r) cos(w t)], the steady state of the outgoing H0^(2) wave, |p| = (w rho Q / 4) |H0^(2)(k r)| (1.57 kPa x |H0|).
Line profile tab (final state): p_radial along +x and p_diagonal along the 45 degree diagonal from 2.25 cells out (the formula is evaluated at the sampled cell centres; errors relative to the curve range ~1 % along +x, which ends at the CPML, ~0.2 % on the diagonal).
Probes tab: probe_1 (r = 1 wavelength) and probe_2 (r = 3 wavelengths, diagonal) with the steady state times the source ramp 1 - exp(-(t - r/c)/tau) (approximate while the ramp lasts, exact after ~20 periods).
Derived values tab: pp_mean_1 / pp_mean_2 = time mean of 2 p^2 over the last 10 periods vs (w rho Q / 4)^2 (J0^2 + Y0^2), and p1_end / p2_end = p at t_end vs the formula; expected 1-3 % (grid dispersion ~1e-3 phase velocity, CPML reflections, the one-cell source).

parameters.name: c_w
parameters.description: sound speed of water in m/s

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size (40 cells per wavelength)

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: domain side (400 cells; 40-cell absorbing layers inside)

parameters.name: Q_rate
parameters.description: peak volume injection rate per m of z in m^2/s

parameters.name: p_amp
parameters.description: Green's function prefactor w rho Q / 4 in Pa

parameters.name: tau_ramp
parameters.description: time constant of the cw switch-on ramp 1 - exp(-t / tau)

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: study duration (an eighth period past whole periods: both J0 and Y0 show)

parameters.name: r2
parameters.description: probe_2 distance (~3 wavelengths, along the diagonal)

analytic_curves.name: p_diagonal
analytic_curves.expression: p_amp*(j0(k_w*hypot(x - x_s, y - y_s))*sin(w_ang*t_end) - y0(k_w*hypot(x - x_s, y - y_s))*cos(w_ang*t_end))
